local LevelRequirements = {}

-- Each value is now the gain required to advance FROM that level.
-- Lv1-50 progression requirements are the current approved cumulative-Strength curve.
local FIXED_STRENGTH = table.freeze({
	[1] = 10,
	[2] = 30,
	[3] = 50,
	[4] = 70,

	[22] = 2010,
	[23] = 2260,

	[25] = 3010,

	[27] = 4010,
	[28] = 4510,
	[29] = 5010,
	[30] = 6010,
	[31] = 7510,
	[32] = 9010,
	[33] = 10010,
	[34] = 12010,
	[35] = 15010,
	[36] = 18010,
	[37] = 22010,
	[38] = 27010,
	[39] = 33010,
	[40] = 40010,
	[41] = 45010,
	[42] = 52010,
	[43] = 60010,
	[44] = 69010,
	[45] = 80010,
	[46] = 95010,
	[47] = 105010,
	[48] = 125010,
	[49] = 150010,
	[50] = 200010,

	-- Lv51-200: explicit provisional thresholds, approved anchors 2026-09-15.
	-- Monotone cubic interpolation was done offline; these literals are authoritative.
})
-- Q(L) is the cost FROM L, never the player's accumulated Strength.
local approved=table.clone(FIXED_STRENGTH)
for level=51,200 do
 local rate=0.20+(level-51)*0.0007
 approved[level]=math.ceil(approved[level-1]*(1+rate)/10)*10
end
FIXED_STRENGTH=table.freeze(approved)

LevelRequirements.FixedStrength = FIXED_STRENGTH
LevelRequirements.LevelStrengthRequirements = FIXED_STRENGTH
LevelRequirements.MaxFixedLevel = 200
LevelRequirements.MaxLevel = 10000
-- Preserve the existing linear extension from the newly approved Q(200).
LevelRequirements.Post200StrengthPerLevel = 250000000

function LevelRequirements.GetRequiredStrength(level)
 local value = tonumber(level) or 1
 if value ~= value then value = 1 end
 value = math.clamp(math.floor(value), 1, LevelRequirements.MaxLevel)
 local fixed = FIXED_STRENGTH[value]
 if fixed ~= nil then return fixed end
 return FIXED_STRENGTH[200] + (value - 200) * LevelRequirements.Post200StrengthPerLevel
end

-- Legacy migration lookup ONLY (and archived tests). Never use for live Level.
-- New progression consumes each current-level requirement in LevelProgression.
function LevelRequirements.CalculateLevel(strength)
 local value = tonumber(strength) or 0
 if value ~= value or value <= 0 then return 1 end
 local low, high = 1, LevelRequirements.MaxLevel
 while low < high do
  local middle = math.floor((low + high + 1) / 2)
  if value >= LevelRequirements.GetRequiredStrength(middle) then
   low = middle
  else
   high = middle - 1
  end
 end
 return low
end

return table.freeze(LevelRequirements)
ReplicatedStorage.Modules.LevelProgressi:
-- Pure rules; LevelRequirements owns all unchanged requirement numbers.
local Requirements=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Config.LevelRequirements)
local M={Version=1}
local function finite(v) return typeof(v)=="number" and v==v and v~=math.huge and v~=-math.huge end
local function validLevel(v) return finite(v) and v%1==0 and v>=1 and v<=Requirements.MaxLevel end
function M.Normalize(raw)
 raw=typeof(raw)=="table" and raw or {}
 local version=raw.LevelProgressVersion
 if version~=nil and version~=M.Version then return nil,"Unsupported LevelProgressVersion" end
 local level=raw.Level
 if level~=nil and not validLevel(level) then return nil,"Invalid saved Level" end
 if version~=nil and (level==nil or raw.LevelProgress==nil) then return nil,"Incomplete saved level state" end
 -- One-time legacy conversion ONLY; prefer an explicitly saved Level.
 if level==nil then level=Requirements.CalculateLevel(raw.Strength) end
 local progress=raw.LevelProgress
 if progress==nil then progress=0 end
 if not finite(progress) or progress<0 then return nil,"Invalid saved LevelProgress" end
 return level,progress
end
function M.Advance(level,progress,gain)
 if not validLevel(level) or not finite(progress) or progress<0 then return nil,"Invalid level state" end
 if not finite(gain) or gain<0 or not finite(progress+gain) then return nil,"Invalid progression gain" end
 -- Lv1 stays at Join/reset; consume its unchanged zero cost on first positive gain.
 if gain==0 then return level,progress end
 progress+=gain
 while level<Requirements.MaxLevel do
  local required=Requirements.GetRequiredStrength(level)
  if progress<required then break end
  progress-=required
  level+=1
 end
 return level,progress -- MaxLevel retains progress but cannot level further.
end
-- Shared by live grants and durable reward snapshots. No mutation or yielding.
function M.ApplyGain(state,gain)
 if not finite(state.Strength) or not finite(gain) or gain<0 or not finite(state.Strength+gain) then return nil,"Invalid Strength gain" end
 local level,progress=M.Advance(state.Level,state.LevelProgress,gain)
 if not level then return nil,progress end
 return state.Strength+gain,level,progress
end
return table.freeze(M)

 [6]=38000,[7]=82000,[8]=198000,[9]=360000,[10]=1000000,
}

C.StageCount=#C.RecommendedLevels

 {UpperExclusive=0.60,Chance=0},
 {UpperExclusive=0.70,Chance=0.25},
 {UpperExclusive=0.80,Chance=0.50},
 {UpperExclusive=0.85,Chance=0.80},
 {UpperExclusive=0.90,Chance=0.85},
 {UpperExclusive=0.95,Chance=0.90},
 {UpperExclusive=1.00,Chance=0.95},
}
function C.GetRequiredStrength(stage) return C.RequiredStrength[stage] end

end

function C.GetLotteryWinChance(ratio)

local function extent(part)
 local cf=part.CFrame;local half=part.Size*.5

 local y=math.abs(r.Y)*half.X+math.abs(u.Y)*half.Y+math.abs(b.Y)*half.Z
 local z=math.abs(r.Z)*half.X+math.abs(u.Z)*half.Y+math.abs(b.Z)*half.Z

 return {part=part,cf=cf,size=part.Size,minX=p.X-x,maxX=p.X+x,minY=p.Y-y,maxY=p.Y+y,minZ=p.Z-z,maxZ=p.Z+z}
end
local function cellsFor(box)
 return math.floor(box.minX/CELL),math.floor(box.maxX/CELL),math.floor(box.minZ/CELL),math.floor(box.maxZ/CELL)
end
local function insert(grid,large,part,box)
 local x0,x1,z0,z1=cellsFor(box)
 local cells={}
 if (x1-x0+1)*(z1-z0+1)>256 then large[part]=box;return cells end
 for x=x0,x1 do for z=z0,z1 do

local function unindex(part,record)

local function overlaps(box,x0,x1,z0,z1,bottom,top)
 return box.maxX>=x0 and box.minX<=x1 and box.maxZ>=z0 and box.minZ<=z1
  and box.maxY>=bottom+.01 and box.minY<=top
end
local function prepareCandidates(origin,target,top)
 startCache()
 if floorsDirty then refreshFloors() end
 for part in pairs(dirty) do local record=records[part];if record then reindex(part,record) end;dirty[part]=nil end
 local x0,x1=math.min(origin.X,target.X)-2,math.max(origin.X,target.X)+2
 local z0,z1=math.min(origin.Z,target.Z)-2,math.max(origin.Z,target.Z)+2
 local bottom=top-256

  if selected[part] or not part.Parent or floorSet[part] or part.Transparency>=1 or part.LocalTransparencyModifier>=.99
   or (route and part:IsDescendantOf(route)) then return end
  box=box or extent(part)

 end

 local cx0,cx1=math.floor(x0/CELL),math.floor(x1/CELL)
 local cz0,cz1=math.floor(z0/CELL),math.floor(z1/CELL)
 for x=cx0,cx1 do for z=cz0,cz1 do
  for part,box in noQueryGrid[x..":"..z] or {} do add(part,box) end
 end end
 for part,box in noQueryLarge do add(part,box) end
 for part in noQueryMoving do if part.Parent then add(part) end end

local function nearCandidates(point,top)

  if not selected[part] and overlaps(box,point.X-1.5,point.X+1.5,point.Z-1.5,point.Z+1.5,point.Y,top) then
   selected[part]=true;table.insert(candidates,part)
  end
 end
 for x=math.floor((point.X-1.5)/CELL),math.floor((point.X+1.5)/CELL) do
  for z=math.floor((point.Z-1.5)/CELL),math.floor((point.Z+1.5)/CELL) do
   for part,box in localGrid[x..":"..z] or {} do add(part,box) end
  end
 end

end
-- Intersect a vertical segment with an asset's oriented bounds. This also
-- catches decorative mats with CanQuery=false; never lift an arrow onto them.
local function blocks(part,point,top)
 local a=part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(point.X,top,point.Z))
 local b=part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point+Vector3.new(0,.01,0))
 local delta=b-a
 local half=part.Size/2
 local low,high=0,1
 for _,axis in {"X","Y","Z"} do
  if math.abs(delta[axis])<.00001 then
   if math.abs(a[axis])>half[axis] then return false end
  else
   local first=(-half[axis]-a[axis])/delta[axis]
   local last=(half[axis]-a[axis])/delta[axis]
   if first>last then first,last=last,first end
   low=math.max(low,first);high=math.min(high,last)
   if low>high then return false end
  end
 end
 return true
end
local function floorOnly(hit,direction,top)

 local forward=(direction-normal*direction:Dot(normal)).Unit
 local side=forward:Cross(normal).Unit

 local points={hit.Position}

 local tip=hit.Position+forward*.65
 for _,sign in {-1,1} do
  local tail=hit.Position-forward*.65+side*(sign*1.05)
  local edge=(tip-tail).Unit:Cross(normal)*.17
  for _,point in {tip,tail,(tip+tail)/2} do
   points[#points+1]=point+edge
   points[#points+1]=point-edge
  end

  local floorHit=workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X,top,point.Z),Vector3.new(0,-256,0),rayParams)

  -- step to another approved walking surface; equipment remains an occluder.
  local tolerance=(carpetSet[hit.Instance] or carpetSet[floorHit.Instance]) and .45 or .08
  if math.abs(floorHit.Position.Y-point.Y)>tolerance then return false end
  highest=math.max(highest,floorHit.Position.Y)
  for _,part in candidates do
   if part.Parent and part.Transparency<1 and part.LocalTransparencyModifier<.99
    and blocks(part,floorHit.Position,top) then return false end
  end

end

  end
 end
 for index=count+1,#pool do assign(pool[index][1],"Transparency",1);assign(pool[index][2],"Transparency",1) end
 attribute(route,"ChevronCount",count)
 attribute(route,"Step1Completed",trained)
 attribute(route,"Step2Completed",enteredWall)
end
local function wallCleared()
 trained=true enteredWall=true
end
local function refresh()
 local character=player.Character
 local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if updateScheduler then updateScheduler() end
 if player:GetAttribute("TutorialCompleted")~=false then
  local egg=player:GetAttribute("EggTutorialTarget")
  local pet=player:GetAttribute("PetMergeTutorialTarget")
  local target=player:GetAttribute("OreTutorialTarget") or egg or pet
  if player:GetAttribute("TutorialCompleted")==true and typeof(target)=="Vector3" and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then show(egg and "BasicEgg" or pet and "PetMerge" or "OreMerge",target)
  else clear();stopCache() end
  return
 end
 if (player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld") or 1)~=1 then hide();stopCache();return end
 if not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then hide();stopCache();return end
 -- Completion is server-owned. Level, boss defeat and Trophy are separate states.
 if (player:GetAttribute("Level") or 1)<2 then
  local treadmill=treadmillFolder:FindFirstChild("Normal01")
  local zone=treadmill and treadmill:FindFirstChild("Area")
  if zone then show("Treadmill",zone.Position) else hide() end
 elseif stage1Defeated then
  -- Stage advances before the owner-only TrophySpawn arrives. Wait for that
  -- event instead of jumping to a Stage2 target during the spawn delay.
  if trophy then show("Trophy"..trophy.Id,trophy.CFrame.Position) else hide() end
 else
  local map=workspace:FindFirstChild("GeneratedMap")
  local corridor=map and map:FindFirstChild("BattleCorridor")
  local stage=corridor and corridor:FindFirstChild("Stage01")
  local model=stage and stage:FindFirstChild("Stage1."..wallIndex)
  local target=model and (wallIndex<=4 and model:FindFirstChild("Wall")
   or model:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawn") or model:FindFirstChild("MiniBossSpawn") or model:FindFirstChild("Floor"))
  if target then show(wallIndex<=4 and ("Wall1."..wallIndex) or "Stage1Boss",target.Position) else hide() end
 end
end
local function trainingChanged()
 if player:GetAttribute("TutorialCompleted")==false and player:GetAttribute("IsTraining")==true then trained=true end
 refresh()
end
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsTraining"):Connect(trainingChanged))
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Level"):Connect(refresh))
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TutorialCompleted"):Connect(trainingChanged))
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OreTutorialTarget"):Connect(refresh))
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EggTutorialTarget"):Connect(refresh))
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PetMergeTutorialTarget"):Connect(refresh))
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TutorialResetSequence"):Connect(function()
 local sequence=player:GetAttribute("TutorialResetSequence")
 if sequence~=resetSequence then
  resetSequence=sequence trained=false enteredWall=false stage1Defeated=false wallIndex=1 trophy=nil clear() refresh()
 end
end))
local elapsed=0
updateScheduler=function()
 local character=player.Character
 local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local original=player:GetAttribute("TutorialCompleted")==false and (player:GetAttribute("CurrentWorld") or 1)==1
 local merge=player:GetAttribute("TutorialCompleted")==true and typeof(player:GetAttribute("OreTutorialTarget"))=="Vector3"
 local egg=player:GetAttribute("TutorialCompleted")==true and typeof(player:GetAttribute("EggTutorialTarget"))=="Vector3"
 local pet=player:GetAttribute("TutorialCompleted")==true and typeof(player:GetAttribute("PetMergeTutorialTarget"))=="Vector3"
 local enabled=(original or merge or egg or pet)
  and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
 if not enabled then
  if tickConnection then tickConnection:Disconnect();tickConnection=nil end
  elapsed=0;return
 end
 if tickConnection then return end
 tickConnection=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  elapsed+=dt
  if elapsed<UPDATE_INTERVAL then return end
  elapsed=0;refresh()
 end)
end
local function bindCharacter(character)
 for _,connection in characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end;table.clear(characterConnections)
 task.spawn(function()
  local humanoid=character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
  local root=character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)
  if player.Character~=character or not humanoid or not root then return end
  table.insert(characterConnections,humanoid.Died:Connect(refresh));refresh()
 end)
end
table.insert(connections,player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
 hide();stopCache();if tickConnection then tickConnection:Disconnect();tickConnection=nil end
 for _,connection in characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end;table.clear(characterConnections)
end))
table.insert(connections,player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter))
table.insert(connections,player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CurrentWorld"):Connect(refresh))
if player.Character then bindCharacter(player.Character) end
trainingChanged()
task.spawn(function()
 local remote=RS.Remotes:WaitForChild("GameRemotes"):WaitForChild("CombatState")
 remoteConnection=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(d)
  if typeof(d)~="table" then return end
  if (d.Type=="EnemyDefeated" or d.Type=="StageCleared") and d.Stage==1 then stage1Defeated=true
  elseif d.Type=="Initialize" then
   trophy=nil wallIndex=1
   stage1Defeated=typeof(d.Cleared)=="table" and d.Cleared[1]==true
  elseif d.Type=="WallCleared" and d.MajorStage==1 then
   wallCleared()
   wallIndex=math.clamp(tonumber(d.Next) or (d.Index+1),1,5)
  elseif d.Type=="WallInitialize" and typeof(d.State)=="table" and d.State.MajorStage==1 then
   wallIndex=math.clamp(tonumber(d.State.Current) or 1,1,5)
   if not d.State.Skipped and typeof(d.State.Cleared)=="table" and d.State.Cleared[1]==true then wallCleared() end
  elseif d.Type=="TrophySpawn" and d.Stage==1 and typeof(d.Id)=="number" and typeof(d.CFrame)=="CFrame" then
   -- Owner-only event from TrophyRewardService. Never scan another player's Trophy.
   wallCleared()
   stage1Defeated=true
   trophy={Id=d.Id,CFrame=d.CFrame}
  elseif d.Type=="TrophyRemoved" and trophy and d.Id==trophy.Id then trophy=nil end
  refresh()
 end)
 remote:FireServer({Type="RequestState"})
end)
script.Destroying:Once(function()
 clear();stopCache()
 if tickConnection then tickConnection:Disconnect();tickConnection=nil end
 for _,connection in characterConnections do connection:Disconnect() end;table.clear(characterConnections)
 if remoteConnection then remoteConnection:Disconnect() end
 for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
end)
StarterGui.StrengthGui.StrengthDisplay:
local player=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Requirements=require(RS.Config:WaitForChild("LevelRequirements"))
local Presentation=require(RS.Modules:WaitForChild("StrengthHUDPresentation"))
local gui=script.Parent
require(RS.Modules.StrengthRewardUI).Build(gui)
local hud=gui:WaitForChild("StrengthLevelHUD")
local panel=hud:WaitForChild("LevelPanel")
local bar=panel:WaitForChild("StrengthProgressBar")
local levelLabel=bar:WaitForChild("Level")
local amountLabel=bar:WaitForChild("Exp")

levelLabel.AutoLocalize=false
amountLabel.AutoLocalize=false
-- Keep the parent containers and style references used by Auto Tap and item effects.
local totalContainer=hud:WaitForChild("StrengthValueContainer")
local totalLabel=totalContainer:WaitForChild("Strength")
totalContainer.Visible=true
totalLabel.AutoLocalize=false
panel:WaitForChild("Level").Visible=false
panel:WaitForChild("ProgressText").Visible=false
panel:WaitForChild("ProgressBackground").Visible=false
local legacy=gui:FindFirstChild("StrengthLabel")
if legacy then legacy.Visible=false end
local function layout()
 require(RS.Modules:WaitForChild("HUDLayout")).Mount(gui).Refresh()
end
local function update()
 local strength=math.max(0,tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Strength")) or 0)
 totalLabel.Text=Presentation.Number(strength)
 local level=tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Level")) or 1
 local levelProgress=math.max(0,tonumber(player:GetAttribute("LevelProgress")) or 0)
 local required=Requirements.GetRequiredStrength(level)
 local atMax=level>=Requirements.MaxLevel
 local progress=atMax and 1 or (required>0 and math.clamp(levelProgress/required,0,1) or 0)
 levelLabel.Text="Lv."..tostring(level)
 amountLabel.Text=Presentation.Number(levelProgress).." / "..(atMax and "MAX" or Presentation.Number(required))
 Presentation.SetFill(bar,progress)

end
-- Read the related replicated attributes together after the current signal batch.
local updateQueued=false
local function queueUpdate()
 if updateQueued then return end
 updateQueued=true
 task.defer(function()
  updateQueued=false
  if script.Parent then update() end
 end)
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Strength"):Connect(queueUpdate)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Level"):Connect(queueUpdate)
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LevelProgress"):Connect(queueUpdate)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(queueUpdate)
gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layout)
layout()
update()
